stem: The old map was ____, so we could not find the way.
expl: 形容词后缀 -less 表示「没有……的」,useless 意为「无用的」,与「找不到路」的结果一致;-ful 表示「有……的」,语义相反。

stem: Reading this book is very ____; I have learnt a lot from it.
expl: -ful 加在名词 help 后构成形容词 helpful「有帮助的」,在句中作表语;-less 表否定,-ly 构成副词,均不合。

stem: The new machine will ____ us to save more energy.
expl: 前缀 en- 加在形容词 able 前构成动词 enable「使能够」,后接「sb. to do」;unable 是形容词,ability 是名词,disable 意为「使丧失能力」,语义相反。

stem: He spoke ____ so that everyone at the back could hear him.
expl: 后缀 -ly 加在形容词 loud 后构成副词 loudly,修饰动词 spoke。

stem: I am not ____ in this old film at all.
expl: -ed 形式的形容词说明人的感受,主语是 I,故用 interested;-ing 形式说明事物本身令人产生某种感受。

stem: "Please water the plants twice a week." In this sentence, the word "water" is used as a ____.
expl: 转化法:名词 water 在此句中直接用作动词,意为「浇水」,前面有祈使句标志 Please,后面带宾语 the plants。

stem: Do not throw the old glass bottles away — we can ____ them into lamps.
expl: 前缀 up- 加在 cycle 前构成动词 upcycle,意为「升级改造」,即把旧物改造成更好的新物。

stem: Without a map we felt ____ in the big city.
expl: -less 表示「没有……的」,helpless 意为「无助的」,说明主语 we 的状态;helpful 意为「有帮助的」,语义相反。

stem: This kind of plastic is ____; it stays in the soil for hundreds of years.
expl: 合成法:形容词 long 与 lasting 合成 long-lasting「耐用的、持久的」,与后半句「留存数百年」呼应。

stem: She has the ____ to solve the problem by herself.
expl: 冠词 the 后面需要名词,故用 able 的名词形式 ability「能力」。

stem: The film was ____, so we left before the end.
expl: 前缀 un- 表否定,uninteresting 意为「无趣的」,-ing 形式说明事物本身的性质,主语是 The film。

stem: The factory must think about the ____ cost of its work.
expl: 后缀 -al 加在名词 environment 后构成形容词 environmental「环境的」,修饰名词 cost。

stem: In which sentence is the word TALK used as a NOUN?
opts: Let us talk about it after class.
They talk too loudly in the library.
I want to talk to the guard.
We had a long talk about upcycling.
expl: 转化法中同一个词可作不同词性,判断依据是它在句中的位置。D 项 talk 前有冠词 a 和形容词 long,作 had 的宾语,是名词;其余三项的 talk 都跟在 to 或主语之后作动词。

stem: Choose the pair that fits: "The teacher was very ____, so the lesson became ____."
expl: 空一修饰人、表示「给予帮助的」,用 -ful 形式 helpful;空二的主语是 the lesson(事物),说明事物本身的性质,用 -ing 形式 interesting。D 项的 interested 只能说明人的感受。

stem: The word UPCYCLE means to change old things into something ____.
expl: 前缀 up- 有「向上、提升」之意,upcycle 指把旧物改造成更好、更有价值的新东西,与单纯的 recycle(回收再处理)不同。
